title: GIRLS / DEMONS
synopsis: Against the neon-lit backdrop of a world inspired by 1990s anime, romance and desire collide with secrecy and supernatural darkness. A story about trust, attraction and the disturbing truths that hide beneath appearances.
awards: Honorable Mention — Higgsfield Global Film Festival 2026
